title: How the Wealthy Use the 72 Rule

scenes.text: Did you know $1,000 can double in just 8 years?
At 9% annual return, money doubles every 8 years.
scenes.label: 9% RETURN DOUBLES

scenes.text: At 6% it takes 12 years – shows power of higher yield.
scenes.label: 6% TAKES 12 YEARS

scenes.text: Even a modest 4% needs 18 years – why the wealthy chase better yields.
scenes.label: 4% NEEDS 18 YEARS

scenes.text: Follow if you're done staying broke.

description: Learn the simple math the rich use to gauge investments and why higher returns matter. Apply the rule today for smarter choices.
